definitions.full: H1662. Gath -hachepher הַחֵ֫פֶר גַּת 2Kin 14:25 ( wine-press of digging home of Jonah, prophet; חֵ֫פֶר גִּתָּ֖הֿ Josh 19:13 , perhaps modern El-Meshhed , approximately 3 miles east of north from Nazareth, Rob BR ii. 350 Bd Pal 252 .
definitions.rootNote: or (abridged) גִּתָּה־חֵפֶר ; from 1660 and 2658 with the article inserted; wine-press of (the) well;

occurrences.englishText: From there it passed along eastward to Gath Hepher, to Ethkazin; and it went out at Rimmon which stretches to Neah.

He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to Yahweh, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.
